nodes.label: piSignage arbitrary file download via path traversal
nodes.precondition: Authenticated as a low-privilege user with remote access to the player API
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary files downloaded from the Raspberry Pi

nodes.label: Oculus Browser HTML injection and potential code execution
nodes.precondition: Victim visits a remote web page using vulnerable Oculus Browser
nodes.postcondition: Attacker can spoof UI and potentially execute code

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop arbitrary file write via hard link
nodes.precondition: Local user access on Windows running vulnerable Oculus Desktop
nodes.postcondition: Ability to write to arbitrary files and gain elevated privileges

nodes.label: RaspAP web console command execution
nodes.precondition: Authenticated access to RaspAP web console
nodes.postcondition: Execution of commands, file uploading, and code execution on the underlying Raspberry Pi OS

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop local privilege escalation via exposed handle
nodes.precondition: Unprivileged process on system running vulnerable Oculus Desktop
nodes.postcondition: Privileged process handle exposed to an unprivileged process, leading to local privilege escalation

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi Glowworm acoustic eavesdropping via power LED
nodes.precondition: Raspberry Pi powers audio equipment playing sound; line of sight to power indicator LED via telescope and electro-optical sensor
nodes.postcondition: Remote attackers can recover speech signals/sound played by speakers

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi OS default credentials
nodes.precondition: Default password for the pi account has not been changed

nodes.label: NVIDIA Jetson Linux IOMMU memory access via PCI bus
nodes.precondition: Physical access to the board and PCI bus access as an unprivileged attacker
nodes.postcondition: Direct read/write access to system address space, potential code execution, DoS, and privilege escalation

Potential code execution creates an unprivileged process capable of receiving exposed privileged handle
